name: UD_Result_Vector
description: Every result transported through the unified loop carries this vector

fields.formula: the K₄ formula (e.g., m_d = m_u × Δ/d)

chain.description: derivation chain from K₄ to result
chain.format: array of links, each: {from, to, status, level}

fields.status: EXACT_STRUCTURAL / OPERATOR_GRAMMAR / WORKING / STRUCTURAL_HYPOTHESIS / OPEN / EXPELLED
fields.error_pct: percentage error vs measurement (null if no measurement)
fields.measured: experimental value (null if not yet measured)
fields.dependencies: list of result IDs this depends on
fields.session: session date when result was computed
fields.phase: which loop phase produced this (CLOSE usually)

DISTINGUISH_checks: no oscillation history on this result
TRANSPORT_decides: gate_status based on chain + uniqueness + external validation
